text:
Support: P1 inbound from AcmeCorp — customers seeing recurring 5xx and timeouts on hosted /v1/generate. Started ~2023-11-02T12:20Z, steadily worse. Posting top headers from the gateway:

Support: headers: x-request-id=acme-9f3, x-route=gateway-hosted-1, latency=~12s, status=504

Liam: grabbing ingress metrics now. I can see request_queue_depth on gateway-hosted-1 spiked to ~11.6k at 12:21 UTC, continuous-batcher backlog queue length jumped and never drained (workers stayed saturated).

Sara: ack. Any auth failures or billing anomalies reported by the customer?

Support: customer page shows repeated retries and duplicate attempts; billing flagged unusual token volumes for one tenant but no auth 401s. They say some requests succeeded intermittently.

Arnav: quick glance at batcher logs — there's a hung batcher thread that kept holding a KV cache lock for >30s, which prevented dequeue. Stack shows repeated attempt to stream a very long prompt (seq_len ~65k) — likely a longseq client.

Liam: oh — continuous batching treats that as a normal request so other short requests got queued behind the long one; queue depth compounding -> timeouts. I see backpressure counters rising, adaptive-shed didn't trigger because seq length wasn't in the route policy.

Mike: mitigation idea: temporary route change to reject longseq > 16k at gateway and enable fallback model route with lower concurrency. Can we push that quick?

Sara: do it. Also enable short-circuit rejects for wait_time > 3s to protect p95. Need to communicate impact to customer first.

Ops-bot: Deploy request accepted: host/gateway-hosted-1 config patch queued by Mike. Rolling change to 6 nodes, canary on 1.

Elaine: confirming auth TTLs are normal for Acme's tokens; nothing suggesting repeated reauth. So root isn't auth.

Liam: adding traces — here's a short excerpt from the batcher log showing the hang:
```
[12:20:45.123] INFO batcher: dequeued batch id=0x7f3 size=1 seq_len=65984 tenant=acme
[12:20:45.124] WARN kvcache: lock acquired for key=model/gpt-large/kv
[12:21:15.992] ERROR batcher: stalled on kvcache lock for 30.9s, holding up dequeue
[12:21:16.001] ERROR gateway: request timeout -> 504 for 12345acme
```

Mike: after canary patch, gateway now rejecting >16k sequences with 413 and routing longseq to dedicated longseq-holding cluster. Queue depth dropped to ~900 in 5m. Clients still seeing tail p99 high but much improved.

Support: Acme confirms fewer 504s, but they noted retries caused duplicate billing spikes — we'll coordinate credits.

Arnav: follow-up: PR to add sequence-length guard in continuous-batcher so very long sequences are spotlighted and either stream separately or gate into longseq pool. Also adding eviction after 5s of holding a KV lock and better observability on locked keys.

Sara: good. Action items: 1) Confirm customer credits and update support ticket (Support), 2) Deploy sequence-length guard and eviction (Arnav/Liam), 3) Update runbook with longseq handling & add adaptive-shed rule (Mike/Sara).

Liam: creating incident postmortem draft and linking metrics/dashboards. Will include p95/p99 before/after, queue_depth timeseries, batcher lock traces.

Support: Customer comms drafted, will send apology + credit. Marking incident resolved for now — monitor for 24h. :white_check_mark:

Ops-bot: Incident status -> mitigated. Monitoring window started at 12:36 UTC.

Sara: thanks team. We'll schedule a short retro tomorrow.
